Captain America.clue: A shield bearer from Brooklyn stands at attention. His compass points not north, but to the heart. The first letter of each word in his motto spells a direction. Airport code: JFK. When the Star-Spangled Man speaks, what does he say to inspire?
Captain America.dialogue: I can do this all day
Captain America.hint_1: Think about Captain America's most repeated phrase across multiple films
Captain America.hint_2: It's said during fights when he refuses to give up

Captain America.clue: Before the serum, before the shield, there was a choice in a back alley. A scientist asks about conviction. The boy from Brooklyn answers with his heart, not his strength. What does he say about fighting?
Captain America.dialogue: I don't like bullies. I don't care where they're from
Captain America.hint_1: This is from The First Avenger, before he became a super soldier
Captain America.hint_2: Dr. Erskine asks him why he wants to join the army
Captain America.hint_3: It's about standing up to those who abuse power

Captain America.clue: In Civil War, divided they stand. Stark speaks of vengeance, but the Sentinel of Liberty speaks of purpose. When asked about their mission, what does the First Avenger declare to Bucky?
Captain America.dialogue: I'm with you till the end of the line
Captain America.hint_1: This line is said to Bucky, his best friend
Captain America.hint_2: It represents unwavering loyalty and friendship

Iron Man.clue: In a cave with a box of scraps, genius meets necessity. Geographic coordinates: 34.0522°N, 118.2437°W. The billionaire returns home to face the press. What declaration does he make that changes everything?
Iron Man.hint_1: This is from the very first Iron Man movie, at the press conference
Iron Man.hint_2: He goes off-script and reveals his secret identity
Iron Man.hint_3: Three words that define his character

Iron Man.clue: Facing mortality after the snap. In Endgame, speaking to his father through time. What does Tony Stark say about his legacy and journey?
Iron Man.dialogue: Part of the journey is the end
Iron Man.hint_1: Said during Endgame, reflecting on mortality and purpose
Iron Man.hint_2: It's a philosophical statement about accepting fate

Iron Man.clue: In Avengers, Loki threatens Earth with an army. The Council speaks of sacrifice. But the man in the armor has confidence. What does he say about their team?
Iron Man.hint_1: Three words expressing confidence in his team
Iron Man.hint_2: It's his response when Loki threatens Earth
Iron Man.hint_3: Shows faith in Banner's alter ego

Thor.clue: The God of Thunder stands before a rainbow bridge. Stripped of power, he learns humility in the New Mexico desert. Coordinates: 32.3199°N, 108.7852°W. What does he say when he finally understands leadership?
Thor.dialogue: I choose to run toward my problems and not away from them
Thor.hint_1: This shows Thor's growth from arrogant prince to worthy hero

Thor.clue: In Ragnarok, facing his sister Hela, he realizes truth. Not in the hammer, but in himself. Lightning code: ⚡⚡⚡. What does the Son of Odin declare about his power?
Thor.dialogue: I am not as strong as you. No. I am stronger
Thor.hint_1: Said during the final battle against Hela
Thor.hint_2: It's about accepting his own strength without the hammer

Thor.clue: To the Guardians, to Rocket, he speaks of loss. In Infinity War, having lost everything—mother, father, brother, home, people. What does Thor say about having nothing left to lose?
Thor.hint_1: This is a rhetorical question showing his despair
Thor.hint_2: He's already lost his family, home, and people

Spider-Man.clue: A boy from Queens receives wisdom from his uncle. Before the mask, before the webs, there was a lesson. Borough code: NYC-Q. What mantra does he live by?
Spider-Man.dialogue: With great power comes great responsibility
Spider-Man.hint_1: This is Spider-Man's most famous quote across all versions
Spider-Man.hint_2: Uncle Ben's wisdom that defines Peter Parker

Spider-Man.clue: On the ferry in Homecoming, he faces consequences. Stark confronts him about worthiness. What does Tony say that becomes Peter's core belief?
Spider-Man.dialogue: If you're nothing without the suit then you shouldn't have it
Spider-Man.hint_1: Tony Stark says this TO Peter
Spider-Man.hint_2: It's about being worthy of power
Spider-Man.hint_3: Lesson about inner heroism versus equipment

Spider-Man.clue: In Far From Home, amid Mysterio's illusions, Peter trusts his instincts. What does Spider-Man say about his unique ability to sense danger?
Spider-Man.hint_1: This is about his unique ability to sense danger
Spider-Man.hint_2: A classic Spider-Man phrase across all adaptations

Black Widow.clue: A spy with red in her ledger speaks to a god in a cell. In Avengers, she manipulates through vulnerability. What metaphor does she use about her past?
Black Widow.dialogue: I've got red in my ledger
Black Widow.hint_1: She's talking about her dark past with Loki

Black Widow.clue: On Vormir, facing an impossible choice. The coordinates of sacrifice. She speaks to Clint, her best friend, about family. What does Natasha say?
Black Widow.hint_1: This is during the soul stone scene in Endgame
Black Widow.hint_2: She's speaking to Clint as they both try to sacrifice themselves

Black Widow.clue: In her own film, facing her past in the Red Room. To her 'sister' Yelena, what does Natasha say about her choices?
Black Widow.dialogue: I chose to go back. It was my choice
Black Widow.hint_1: About returning to confront her past

Hulk.clue: A scientist's secret revealed in Avengers. Fury asks about control. Banner speaks of his constant state. What is his secret?
Hulk.dialogue: That's my secret Cap. I'm always angry
Hulk.hint_1: This reveals how Banner controls the Hulk
Hulk.hint_2: Said right before he transforms to fight the Chitauri

Hulk.clue: In Ragnarok, speaking as Hulk on Sakaar. Thor tries to reason with the Green Goliath. What does Hulk say about their friendship?
Hulk.hint_1: Hulk is asserting his own identity separate from Banner
Hulk.hint_2: He doesn't want to be Banner anymore

Hulk.clue: In Endgame, Professor Hulk explains his evolution. At the diner, he describes the merger. What does he say about his transformation?
Hulk.dialogue: I put the brains and the brawn together
Hulk.hint_1: He's explaining how Banner and Hulk merged into one
Hulk.hint_2: It's about combining intelligence with strength

Black Panther.clue: A king rises in the ritual challenge. Waterfall coordinates: fictional Wakanda. He speaks the words of his people before combat. What does T'Challa say?
Black Panther.hint_2: Said throughout Black Panther and Endgame

Black Panther.clue: In Civil War, facing Zemo after revenge consumed him. At the facility, he makes a choice about vengeance. What does the Panther say?
Black Panther.dialogue: Vengeance has consumed you. It's consuming them. I'm done letting it consume me
Black Panther.hint_1: He's choosing to break the cycle of revenge
Black Panther.hint_2: Said when he decides not to kill Zemo

Black Panther.clue: Before the UN, T'Challa speaks of Wakanda's future. He quotes his father T'Chaka about unity. What wisdom does he share?
Black Panther.dialogue: In times of crisis the wise build bridges while the foolish build barriers
Black Panther.hint_1: This is T'Chaka's wisdom that T'Challa quotes

Doctor Strange.clue: A surgeon's hands tremble in New York. Coordinates: NYC Hospital. Before magic, there was ego. What does Strange say about his purpose as a doctor?
Doctor Strange.dialogue: I became a doctor to save lives not to take them
Doctor Strange.hint_1: Shows his core values despite his arrogance
Doctor Strange.hint_2: Said when discussing his medical oath

Doctor Strange.clue: On Titan, facing Thanos with 14,000,605 futures seen. One finger raised. What does the Sorcerer Supreme say about their situation?
Doctor Strange.hint_1: This line foreshadowed the title of the next film
Doctor Strange.hint_2: Said after viewing all possible futures
Doctor Strange.hint_3: Five words about the final phase

Doctor Strange.clue: The Ancient One teaches about letting go. Trapped in a time loop with Dormammu. What does Strange declare repeatedly in the Dark Dimension?
Doctor Strange.hint_1: Repeated many times in a time loop
Doctor Strange.hint_2: How he defeats Dormammu through persistence

Ant-Man.clue: A thief becomes a hero in San Francisco. Pym teaches about size and heart. Airport code: SFO. What does Scott say about being this hero with a silly name?
Ant-Man.dialogue: I'm Ant-Man. I know it wasn't my idea
Ant-Man.hint_2: Shows his insecurity about the name

Ant-Man.clue: In Civil War, at the Leipzig airport battle. Cap needs help. Scott reveals his greatest trick and says something before going giant. What transformation does he announce?
Ant-Man.dialogue: I guess I got to get big
Ant-Man.hint_1: He says this before becoming Giant-Man
Ant-Man.hint_2: His big moment in Civil War—literally

Ant-Man.clue: To Cassie, his daughter, he makes a promise. A father's love drives him through everything. What does Scott say about being there for her?
Ant-Man.dialogue: I love you so much. You're my little girl
Ant-Man.hint_1: Shows his motivation—being a good father
Ant-Man.hint_2: Said to Cassie in emotional moments

Scarlet Witch.clue: In Sokovia, twins volunteer for experiments. Hatred for Stark drives them. In Age of Ultron, what does Wanda say about her telepathic powers?
Scarlet Witch.dialogue: I can read him. He's dreaming
Scarlet Witch.hint_2: Said when using her powers on someone

Scarlet Witch.clue: In Infinity War, Vision speaks of sacrifice. Wanda faces an impossible choice in Wakanda destroying the Mind Stone. What does she say as she loses their connection?
Scarlet Witch.hint_1: Said to Vision as she destroys the Mind Stone
Scarlet Witch.hint_2: About their psychic connection being severed

Scarlet Witch.clue: In WandaVision's finale, the Scarlet Witch emerges. What does Agatha Harkness reveal about Wanda's true nature and power?
Scarlet Witch.dialogue: You have no idea how dangerous you are. You're supposed to be a myth
Scarlet Witch.hint_1: Agatha says this TO Wanda about her destiny
Scarlet Witch.hint_2: About being the Scarlet Witch from prophecy
